description_zh: 全部使用有機認證原料，麵團至少發酵 24 小時；由烘焙師父子一起經營。
description_en: Certified organic ingredients and at least 24 hours of fermentation; run by a baker and his son.
notes: RAS 2024 參賽地址 Balmain（300 Darling St），該址現在是另一家 Balmain Bread，不建門市；2024 的獎記在品牌。Cronulla 專櫃官網寫即將開幕，未建。介紹來源：官網 https://bonfirebread.com.au/（2026-11-02）

description_zh: 整間店以酸種為主，連可頌、巧克力麵包、餅乾都用酸種麵團做。
description_en: Sourdough runs through everything here, even the croissants, pain au chocolat and cookies.
notes: RAS 參賽地址 Varsity Lakes 是烘焙廠（bakehouse），不上地圖。介紹來源：RAS 2026 官方結果的產品名（Sourdough Croissant、Sourdough Pain au Chocolate、Sourdough Peanut Cookie）

description_zh: 以酥皮點心見長，也賣在家自己烤的半成品酥皮。
description_en: Known for pastry, including take-home pastries you bake in your own oven.
notes: RAS 參賽地址 Fyshwick ACT 2609，Fyshwick 有兩間門市，獎記在品牌。另有週六 Capital Region Farmers Market 攤位，不建。介紹來源：官網 https://threemillsbakery.com.au/「Hand made by us, baked by you」（2026-11-02）

description_zh: 經營的家族在 1980 年代就在超市裡設了現做烘焙部，是最早這樣做的超市之一；烘焙由 Rob Trimboli 帶領。
description_en: The family behind it put one of the first from-scratch bakeries into a supermarket in the 1980s; Rob Trimboli leads the baking.
notes: NABC 2026 得獎者寫「Robert Trimboli - Adelaide's Finest Bakeries & Patisserie」，沒指定門市 → 兩間都收（D2 補充 2026-10-28）。介紹來源：InDaily 2026-06-22 https://www.indailysa.com.au/citymag/food-drink/2026/06/22/upper-crust-australias-best-bread-is-in-adelaide

description_zh: 2009 年 Gleeson 兄弟用一台 5 公斤烘豆機起家，是中央海岸最早的精品烘豆商之一。
description_en: Started by the Gleeson brothers in 2009 on a 5 kg roaster; one of the Central Coast's first specialty roasters.
notes: 官網沒有門市頁，門市取自 Google Maps。Brisbane 店永久歇業，未建。介紹來源：https://centralcoastlifeandstyle.com.au/glee-the-o-g-of-coastie-coffee、https://coastiesmag.com.au/?p=14002

description_zh: 南高地家族經營 30 年的甜點店，兩代甜點師一起在廚房裡做。
description_en: A family patisserie in the Southern Highlands for 30 years, with two generations of pastry chefs in the kitchen.
notes: RAS 參賽地址 Mittagong，獎記在品牌。介紹來源：VisitNSW https://www.visitnsw.com/destinations/country-nsw/southern-highlands/mittagong/food-and-drink/the-gumnut-patisserie；Foodservice Rep（兩代甜點師）

description_zh: 全店無麩質；創辦人和女兒都有乳糜瀉，是新州第一家通過澳洲乳糜瀉協會認證的麵包店。
description_en: Entirely gluten-free, started by a founder who, like her daughter, has coeliac disease; the first NSW bakery accredited by Coeliac Australia.
notes: RAS 參賽地址 Alexandria（也是門市），RAS 獎記在品牌。介紹來源：https://www.afsydney.com.au/about/wholegreen-bakery/

description_zh: 家族經營的手工麵包店，強調慢工製程、不加防腐劑。
description_en: A family-owned artisan bakery that stresses a slow process and no preservatives.
notes: 介紹來源：官網 https://slowbreads.com.au/（2026-11-02）

description_zh: 主廚 Matt Taylor 在米其林餐廳和五星飯店做了近 20 年甜點；可頌每天手工做，一批要花三天。
description_en: Chef Matt Taylor spent almost 20 years in Michelin-starred restaurants and five-star hotels; the croissants are made by hand daily over three days.
notes: RAS 登記網站 www.crois.au 目前是 Shopify「store unavailable」頁，網站欄先空白；上線前再確認營業。介紹來源：Time Out https://www.timeout.com/sydney/news/one-of-australias-best-croissants-is-hiding-at-this-nsw-bakery-092926

description_zh: Troy 和 Samantha Hindmarch 夫妻經營，法式甜點、蛋糕和麵包都在店裡從頭手工做。
description_en: Run by Troy and Samantha Hindmarch; French-style pastries, cakes and bread are made from scratch on site.
notes: NABC 只寫店名＋人名，沒有地址；店主 Troy Hindmarch 和得獎者對上（CANDIDATES.md）。介紹來源：The Bugle 2025-08；https://kiama.com.au/listings/eat-drink/parfait-patiserie

description_zh: Black Star Pastry 創辦人 Christopher Thé 開的新麵包店。
description_en: The new bakery from Christopher Thé, founder of Black Star Pastry.
notes: RAS 2024 另有學徒獎（James Hammond），學生獎不收。介紹來源：官網 https://www.hearthe.com.au/（CANDIDATES.md 2026-10-28）

description_zh: 法國夫妻 Adrien、Cécile Bochel 從市集攤位起家，專做波爾多可麗露（canelé）。
description_en: French couple Adrien and Cécile Bochel started at market stalls, specialising in Bordeaux canelés.
notes: Freshwater 店官網寫已永久關閉，不建。介紹來源：SBS https://www.sbs.com.au/food/article/2019/07/12/two-frenchies-resurrecting-16th-century-dessert

description_zh: 法國甜點師 Yves Scherrer 的店；他做過 140 多種閃電泡芙，也是澳洲甜點世界盃隊的教練。
description_en: Run by French pastry chef Yves Scherrer, who has made more than 140 kinds of éclair and coaches Australia's World Pastry Cup team.
notes: 也做批發。介紹來源：SBS https://www.sbs.com.au/food/article/2020/02/03/pastry-chef-can-make-more-140-types-eclairs；Concrete Playground

description_zh: 法國主廚 Sébastien 的全無麩質廚房，從肉派到閃電泡芙都不含麩質。
description_en: French chef Sébastien's entirely gluten-free kitchen, from meat pies to éclairs.
notes: 介紹來源：Broadsheet https://www.broadsheet.com.au/sydney/leichhardt/cafes/sebastien-sans-gluten；Not Quite Nigella 2022-04-12

description_zh: 葡式蛋塔專門店，用創辦人 Diogo Ferreira 已故父親的家傳食譜，2017 年從小窗口店起家。
description_en: Portuguese tarts from founder Diogo Ferreira's late father's family recipe; started in 2017 as a hole-in-the-wall.
notes: RAS 參賽地址 Marrickville 不是門市，獎記在品牌。介紹來源：Foodservice Rep https://www.foodservicerep.com.au/bakery-trends/136/the-man-behind-tuga-pastries-shares-the-story-of-its-success

description_zh: 全店無麩質，創辦人 Sandra Hudson 一開始是想讓孩子的午餐有無麩質的選擇。
description_en: Entirely gluten-free; founder Sandra Hudson started out wanting gluten-free food for her children's lunches.
notes: 週日、一公休；另有 3 個週六農夫市集攤位，不收。介紹來源：Broadsheet https://www.broadsheet.com.au/sydney/bondi-junction/cafes/hudsons

description_zh: 2014 年從市集攤位起家的甜甜圈店，2016 年在 The Junction 開旗艦店，也賣自製義式冰淇淋。
description_en: A doughnut shop that began at markets in 2014 and opened its flagship at The Junction in 2016; it also makes its own gelato.
notes: RAS 2025 參賽名稱是 MILKJAM CO PTY LTD（同地址，官方的生產者欄寫 DOUGHHEADS、網站 doughheads.com.au），收進 Doughheads。Newcastle Herald 報導店東想出售 The Junction 店，上線前再確認營業。介紹來源：Newcastle Herald https://www.newcastleherald.com.au/story/9018727/newcastles-doughheads-claims-top-spot-at-2025-donut-comp；inkl（冰淇淋）

description_zh: Nowra 經營十多年的在地麵包店，賣派、香草千層和全麥、酸種麵包。
description_en: A local Nowra bakery of more than a decade, selling pies, vanilla slices and wholegrain and sourdough bread.
notes: 沒有官網。RAS 寫 East Nowra，Google Maps 寫 Nowra，郵遞區號都是 2541，附近只有這一家同名店。介紹來源：Localsearch https://www.localsearch.com.au/profile/bakehouse-delights/nowra-nsw-2541/jkKf；Wanderlog

description_zh: Ivy Tran 經營的蛋糕店，客製蛋糕和馬卡龍都在店裡從頭做。
description_en: Ivy Tran's cake shop; custom cakes and macarons are made from scratch on site.
notes: 週一、二、四只開下午。介紹來源：Mosman Collective https://mosmancollective.com/food-drink/sweet-ivy-serves-up-classic-cakes-and-custom-creations-in-mosman/

description_zh: Gabriela Oporto 的蛋糕店，做過 Taylor Swift 的蛋糕，也做無麩質、無糖、純素等特殊飲食的蛋糕。
description_en: Gabriela Oporto's cake shop, which has baked for Taylor Swift and makes cakes for gluten-free, sugar-free and vegan diets.
notes: 官網寫 our Forestville shop。介紹來源：Manly Observer https://manlyobserver.com.au/taylor-swift-buys-eras-tour-cake-from-northern-beaches-bakery/；Baking Business https://bakingbusiness.com.au/five-minutes-with-gabriela-oporto-of-bakealicious/

description_zh: 前高級餐廳主廚 Vivian Wang 的全無麩質甜點店，招牌是巴斯克乳酪蛋糕。
description_en: Former fine-dining chef Vivian Wang's entirely gluten-free dessert shop, best known for its Basque cheesecake.
notes: 沒有官網，只有 Instagram／Facebook；Google Maps 分類咖啡店。介紹來源：TAFE NSW https://www.tafensw.edu.au/about/media/graduate-whips-up-success-with-gluten-free-desserts

description_zh: 聖誕布丁專門店，用家傳食譜在 Newcastle 全程手工做、手工包布。
description_en: Christmas pudding specialists, made and cloth-wrapped by hand in Newcastle from a family recipe.
notes: 官網聯絡頁寫 PUDDING LANE SHOP；工廠門市，週一到週五 8:00–16:00。介紹來源：The Senior https://www.thesenior.com.au/story/7015012/time-to-order-your-christmas-pudding/

description_zh: 全店純素、無麩質，自己做米麵包和甜甜圈，也賣素壽司。
description_en: Entirely vegan and gluten-free; it makes its own rice bread and doughnuts and also serves vegan sushi.
notes: Google Maps 名稱 Comeco Cafe & Sushi Bar；主業咖啡店兼烘焙，收（得獎品項是 Hot Cross Buns）。介紹來源：官網 https://www.comecofoods.com.au/（CANDIDATES.md 2026-10-28）

description_zh: Terrey Hills 的高級食材超市，店裡有自己的廚師團隊。
description_en: A premium grocer in Terrey Hills with its own in-house team of chefs.
notes: 超市，依 D2 加「超市內烘焙」標籤。介紹來源：官網 https://forestwayfresh.com/（CANDIDATES.md 2026-10-28）

description_zh: 1980 年從墨爾本 Hawthorn 一家店起步的連鎖麵包店；這裡只列拿到獎的三間加盟店。
description_en: A bakery chain that grew from one shop in Hawthorn, Melbourne in 1980; only the three award-winning franchise stores are listed.
notes: 連鎖加盟，依 D2 只收得獎的門市：Lane Cove（RAS 2025 金 2）、Albion Park Rail（NABC 2025 第 1）。NABC 2025 的 Bowral 店只有第 2、3 名，沒過門檻，不收。昆州賽加 Arana Hills（2024 店名參賽、2025 Adam Kane 代表；官方 2024 拼成 Alana Hills）；Hervey Bay 只有第 2、3 名，不收。介紹來源：https://www.bakersdelight.com.au/company

description_zh: 前銀行員 George Kalpakis 和當律師的太太 Caroline 一起創立的布朗尼專門店。
description_en: A brownie specialist founded by former banker George Kalpakis and his wife Caroline, a lawyer.
notes: 官網是網購＋批發；Thomastown 工廠門市，週一到週五 10:00–15:30（Google Maps，評論提到走進店裡買）。介紹來源：AGFG https://www.agfg.com.au/article/brazen-brownies-awardwinning-artisans-redefining-australias-love-for-the-humble-brownie

description_zh: Oakleigh East 的歐式甜點和手工麵包店，也接婚禮、生日的客製蛋糕。
description_en: A European-style patisserie and artisan bakery in Oakleigh East that also makes cakes to order for weddings and birthdays.
notes: NABC 只寫店名；官網「Media & Awards」頁、地址相同，身分對上（CANDIDATES.md）。介紹來源：AGFG https://www.agfg.com.au/restaurant/piece-of-cake-bakery-89670

description_zh: Yarra Valley 入口的在地麵包店，以酸種麵包和派出名。
description_en: A local bakery at the gateway to the Yarra Valley, known for its sourdough and pies.
notes: NABC 只寫店名；Upper Yarra Star Mail 2024-06-25 報導 Open Sourdough 第 1 和 National Champion Sourdough Loaf，身分對上。目錄網站另有 Harrys Bakery 同地址，上線前再確認店名。介紹來源：Mount Evelyn Star Mail 2024-06-28 https://mountevelyn.mailcommunity.com.au/news/2024-06-28/wandin-bakerys-sourdough-unrivalled-and-pies-among-the-best/

description_zh: 藏在 Percy St 黑色大門後面的麵包坊，只做天然發酵的酸種麵包和酥皮點心。
description_en: A bakehouse behind black gates on Percy St, making only naturally leavened sourdough and pastries.
notes: Google Maps 名稱「Sourdough.」；Instagram 貼文提到 July 2024 national awards，身分對上（較弱）。介紹來源：Visit Great Ocean Road https://visitgreatoceanroad.org.au/?p=9149

description_zh: Coles 超市；得獎的是店內烘焙部的烘焙師，這裡只列得獎的兩間：Darwin Casuarina Square、布里斯本南邊的 Park Ridge。
description_en: Coles supermarkets; the awards went to bakers in the in-store bakeries, so only the two winning stores are listed: Casuarina Square in Darwin and Park Ridge, south of Brisbane.
notes: 超市，依 D2 只收得獎的 Casuarina 這一間，加「超市內烘焙」標籤。NABC 2026 寫「Luke Moy - Coles Casuarina」；昆州賽 2026 也是 Luke Moy（官方拼成 Casurina）。昆州賽加 Park Ridge（Ashley Hughes，2024）；Beaudesert（Lauren Robin）只有第 2 名，不收

description_zh: Mid North Coast 第一家咖啡烘豆商，用鑄鐵滾筒烘豆機，也烘自家在印度農園的豆子。
description_en: The Mid North Coast's first coffee roaster, using a cast-iron drum roaster and roasting beans from its own farm in India.
notes: 烘豆商的獎記在品牌；Port Macquarie 烘焙廠兼咖啡店（比照 Glee HQ 標工廠門市）。介紹來源：VisitNSW https://visitnsw.com/destinations/north-coast/port-macquarie-area/port-macquarie/food-and-drink/peak-coffee；Coastbeat

description_zh: 2014 年在 South Brisbane 開第一間咖啡店的家族烘豆商，旗艦烘焙廠在 Woolloongabba。
description_en: A family roaster that opened its first café in South Brisbane in 2014; its flagship roastery is in Woolloongabba.
notes: 烘豆商的獎記在品牌。也在布里斯本咖啡廳頁（CF02），可互相標註。RAS 2025 Champion Coffee 依 D4 不收。Time Out 寫共 4 間店，這裡只有 Step 1b 查到的 3 間，上線前再查。介紹來源：BeanScene https://www.beanscenemag.com.au/meet-the-founder-of-queenslands-coffee-mentality/；Time Out

description_zh: 店名來自創辦人養的邊境牧羊犬「GaBee」；2022 年從市中心擴展到北區的 Chermside。
description_en: Named after the founder's border collie, GaBee; it expanded from the city to Chermside in the north in 2022.
notes: 烘豆商的獎記在品牌（2024 Cat 10 產品名寫 OGABEE @ BIRKDALE，仍記品牌）。官網「Our Cafes & Locations」寫 Brisbane 4 間。介紹來源：Westfield Chermside https://www.westfield.com.au/chermside/store/5mnxEP76FZ2xYdp7gyqbLP/o-gabee-and-co-coffee

description_zh: 北昆士蘭的咖啡烘豆商，也替當地咖啡店供應咖啡機。
description_en: A North Queensland coffee roaster that also supplies coffee machines to local cafés.
notes: 烘豆商的獎記在品牌；Rosslea 烘焙廠兼咖啡吧（比照 Glee HQ 標工廠門市）。目錄網站另寫 Annandale Central 有 Coffee Presto Espresso Bar，上線前再查。介紹來源：Townsville bdmag https://www.bdmag.com.au/?p=16799

description_zh: Chippendale 旗艦店主打體驗：客人可以在店裡走動，近距離看咖啡師沖煮。
description_en: The Chippendale flagship is built around the experience: guests can wander in and watch the baristas brew up close.
notes: 世界百大咖啡店只收官方店家頁寫的那一間（使用者 2026-11-02 選 A）。介紹來源：官方店家頁 https://theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com/locales/tobbys-estate/

description_zh: 墨爾本精品咖啡的先驅之一，和咖啡農長期合作採購，也有完整的早午餐和茶單。
description_en: One of Melbourne's specialty coffee pioneers, buying through long-standing producer relationships, with a full brunch menu and tea list.
notes: 世界百大咖啡店只收官方店家頁寫的那一間（使用者 2026-11-02 選 A）。介紹來源：官方店家頁 https://theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com/locales/proud-mary-coffee/

description_zh: 布里斯本市中心的精品咖啡店，同時供應澳洲和國外烘豆商的咖啡，也以早餐和酥皮點心出名。
description_en: A Brisbane CBD specialty coffee shop pouring Australian and international roasters, also known for its breakfasts and pastries.
notes: 世界百大咖啡店只收官方店家頁寫的那一間（使用者 2026-11-02 選 A）。介紹來源：官方店家頁 https://theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com/locales/coffee-anthology/

description_zh: 2002 年起在墨爾本烘豆的 Veneziano，開在機場第一航廈的旗艦店。
description_en: The Terminal 1 airport flagship of Veneziano, roasting in Melbourne since 2002.
notes: 世界百大咖啡店只收官方店家頁寫的那一間（使用者 2026-11-02 選 A）。介紹來源：官方店家頁 https://theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com/locales/veneziano-coffee-roasters/（現在 404，內容取自 Wayback 2025 存檔）

description_zh: Fitzroy 的咖啡店，創辦人 Alicia 多年來在澳洲推廣雲南咖啡。
description_en: A Fitzroy café whose founder, Alicia, has spent years championing Yunnan coffee in Australia.
notes: 世界百大咖啡店只收官方店家頁寫的那一間（使用者 2026-11-02 選 A）。介紹來源：官方店家頁 https://theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com/locales/calere-coffee/（現在 404，內容取自 Wayback 2025 存檔）

description_zh: 2013 年創立，想讓精品咖啡變得平易近人的阿德萊德咖啡店。
description_en: An Adelaide coffee shop founded in 2013 to make specialty coffee approachable.
notes: 世界百大咖啡店只收官方店家頁寫的那一間（使用者 2026-11-02 選 A）。介紹來源：官方店家頁 https://theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com/locales/exchange-coffee/（現在 404，內容取自 Wayback 2025 存檔）

description_zh: Albion 公園對面、粗獷工業風的咖啡店，除了咖啡也賣冰啤酒，一週七天營業。
description_en: A rustic, edgy café across from a park in Albion, serving cold beer as well as coffee, seven days a week.
notes: 世界百大咖啡店只收官方店家頁寫的那一間（使用者 2026-11-02 選 A）。介紹來源：官方店家頁 https://theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com/locales/fonzie-abbott/（現在 404，內容取自 Wayback 2025 存檔）

description_zh: 自家小團隊在墨爾本烘豆，店面挑高 8 公尺。
description_en: Roasted by its own small team in Melbourne and served in an eight-metre-high space.
notes: 世界百大咖啡店只收官方店家頁寫的那一間（使用者 2026-11-02 選 A）。介紹來源：官方店家頁 https://theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com/locales/vacation-coffee/

description_zh: 2007 年創立，從採購、烘豆、批發到門市一手包辦，重視咖啡豆的可追溯性。
description_en: Founded in 2007, it sources, roasts, wholesales and brews its own coffee, with traceability at its core.
notes: 世界百大咖啡店只收官方店家頁寫的那一間（使用者 2026-11-02 選 A）。介紹來源：官方店家頁 https://theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com/locales/seven-seeds/（現在 404，內容取自 Wayback 2025 存檔）

description_zh: 極簡風的濃縮咖啡吧，走純粹的精品咖啡路線；也是 2026 大洋洲最佳咖啡店。
description_en: A minimalist espresso bar with a purist approach to specialty coffee; also named Oceania's Best Coffee Shop 2026.
notes: 世界百大咖啡店只收官方店家頁寫的那一間（使用者 2026-11-02 選 A）。介紹來源：官方店家頁 https://theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com/locales/only-coffee-project-crows-nest/

description_zh: 嘗試用科技提升咖啡的品質和穩定度，讓咖啡師把心力放在跟客人互動。
description_en: Uses technology to make coffee better and more consistent, freeing baristas to focus on their guests.
notes: 世界百大咖啡店只收官方店家頁寫的那一間（使用者 2026-11-02 選 A）。介紹來源：官方店家頁 https://theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com/locales/beta-coffee/

description_zh: 2003 年起的精品咖啡先驅，Reservoir St 旗艦店有世界首創的自助批次滴濾吧。
description_en: A specialty pioneer since 2003; its Reservoir St flagship has the world-first self-serve batch brew bar.
notes: 世界百大咖啡店只收官方店家頁寫的那一間（使用者 2026-11-02 選 A）。介紹來源：官方店家頁 https://theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com/locales/single-o/

description_zh: 布里斯本南區 Acacia Ridge 的麵包甜點店；2025、2026 連兩年拿下昆士蘭烘焙賽的蛋糕／酥點冠軍（香草片、焦糖片）。
description_en: A bakery and patisserie in Acacia Ridge, south Brisbane; Champion Cake / Pastry at the Queensland Baking Show two years running (2025 vanilla slice, 2026 caramel slice).
notes: 2025 寫「Leon Ly LTT Patisserie」、2026 寫「LTT Patisserie Acacia Ridge」。Leon Ly 也是 Yamanto Central Patisserie 的老闆（prwire 2023-10-16），兩家分開建。介紹來源：官方結果 PDF

description_zh: 布里斯本北區的麵包店，Taigum 和 Carseldine 兩間門市各自參賽、各自得獎。
description_en: A bakery in Brisbane's north; its Taigum and Carseldine shops enter, and win, separately.
notes: 官方每次都寫到門市（Rays Patisserie Taigum／Carseldine），獎掛各自門市。介紹來源：官方結果 PDF

description_zh: 布里斯本東邊 Redlands 一帶的手工麵包店；官網說店裡的酸種老麵收在比利時 Saint Vith 的酸種圖書館，是第 66 號、澳洲唯一一個。
description_en: An artisan bakery in the Redlands, east of Brisbane; its website says its sourdough culture is No. 66 in the Sourdough Library in Saint Vith, Belgium, the only one from Australia.
notes: 官方只寫「人名 Uncle Bobs Bakery」，沒寫門市，照 D2 列營業中的 Belmont、Thornlands 兩間（Victoria Point、Redland Bay 已歇業）。身分：昆州只有這一家 Uncle Bobs Bakery，官網寫有參加全國和國際烘焙比賽（https://unclebobs.com.au/awards），Baking Business 2025-05-15 報導冠軍麵包「Connor McNaught from Uncle Bobs Bakery」。介紹來源：https://unclebobs.com.au/awards（2026-11-03）

description_zh: Burpengary 的肉店（Google 分類是肉店），派是店裡自己做的；2023、2024 連兩年拿下昆士蘭烘焙賽的蛋糕／酥點冠軍。
description_en: A butcher in Burpengary that makes its own pies; Champion Cake / Pastry at the Queensland Baking Show in 2023 and 2024.
notes: 使用者 2026-11-02 選 A：肉店也收，類型標烘焙。身分：Great Aussie Pie Competition 2025 結果寫「The Squealing Pig, Burpengary QLD」；Baking Business 2024-05-28 寫連兩年冠軍（2023 是 BBQ pulled pork and cheese pie）。介紹來源：上述兩篇

description_zh: Ipswich 的 Yamanto Central 商場一進門左手邊的麵包甜點店，2021 年開業。
description_en: A bakery and patisserie just inside the entrance of Yamanto Central shopping centre in Ipswich, open since 2021.
notes: 不是隔壁 Yamanto Shopping Village（512 Warwick Rd）的 Yamanto Bakery。老闆 Leon Ly（也是 LTT Patisserie）。介紹來源：商場業主 JMK Retail 新聞稿 https://prwire.com.au/pr/111827/www.jmkretail.com.au（2023-10-16）

description_zh: Woolworths 超市；得獎的是店內烘焙部的烘焙師，這裡只列得獎的兩間：布里斯本 Lutwyche、新州 Tweed City。
description_en: Woolworths supermarkets; the awards went to bakers in the in-store bakeries, so only the two winning stores are listed: Lutwyche in Brisbane and Tweed City in NSW.
notes: 超市，依 D2 只收得獎的門市。Lutwyche：2024 寫 Grace Stegeman、2025 寫 Grace Netov；Tweed City：Luke Moy（2026 改代表 Coles Casuarina）。Nundah（Grace Netov 2026）的第 1 名同班都沒有第 2 名，被 D11 擋掉；Cannon Hill 只有第 3 名

description_zh: 連鎖加盟麵包店；這裡只列得獎的 Toowoomba Westridge 店。
description_en: A franchise bakery chain; only the award-winning Westridge store in Toowoomba is listed.
notes: 連鎖加盟，依 D2 只收得獎門市。官方寫「Elizabeth Green Brumby's Westridge」
